journey.name: import selected prepared contacts
journey.description: Precondition: the import preview is open for a disposable Ring identity with at least three known follows that are not yet saved in this Bitkit wallet.

actions.action: Deselect one contact and note its name
Verify the import finishes and the Let Your Contacts Pay You screen appears
Return Home and open Contacts from the menu
Verify the selected contacts are present and the deselected contact is absent
